blocks.text: DEL CARMEN, Surigao del Norte — Rep. Brian Poe of the FPJ Panday Bayanihan party-list has been named honorary adviser of the Climate Field School, reaffirming his commitment to advancing climate resilience and sustainable livelihoods in Siargao. Poe was represented by his chief for political affairs, Leaross Valerio, at the Siargao Climate and Circular Economy
